name: omniforce-mcp
description: AI-search visibility: GEO audits, tracked prompts, competitors, citations.
long_description: OmniForce is a GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) & AI-search visibility platform. This extension exposes it to any Model Context Protocol client: run an evidence-based GEO audit of any URL (keyless), and read your tracked prompts, competitors, visibility runs, and reports. It also surfaces your plan, usage, and a one-click upgrade link.

api_key.title: OmniForce API Key
api_key.description: Optional. Enables the monitoring tools (tracked prompts, competitors, runs, reports). Leave blank to use the keyless GEO scan only. Create one at https://www.omniforce.run/.

tools.name: omniforce_geo_scan
tools.description: Audit a website's GEO/AI-search readiness (no API key required).

tools.name: omniforce_get_brand
tools.description: Return the authenticated tenant's brand profile.

tools.name: omniforce_list_prompts
tools.description: List tracked prompts across answer engines.

tools.name: omniforce_account
tools.description: Plan tier, usage, and available upgrades.

tools.name: omniforce_upgrade
tools.description: Create a hosted checkout link to upgrade the plan.
